findings.summary: Partner cap aggregate ignores completion-based reward transactions
findings.details: The per-currency partner cap total only counts RewardTransaction rows that join through ClaimAction -> PurchaseOrder. But TrainingCompletionService, ActivityCompletionService, and JourneyCompletionService pass partnerCompanyId with claimActionId = null, so those awarded rows are excluded from the aggregate. Any training/activity/journey reward with a partner cap can keep awarding beyond the configured cap because prior completion awards are invisible to the cap check.
findings.recommendation: Persist partnerCompanyId directly on reward_transactions, then rewrite both partner-cap aggregate queries to use the column directly instead of joining through ClaimAction -> PurchaseOrder.
